answer: Each task’s nonce and scoring seed are derived from a specified future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward. Participants commit their identity before the pulse, then submit a solution bound to the revealed value. This blocks advance tabulation and makes parallel sybil grinding costly rather than reusable. A relic, meadow, or canyon label may be task input, but is never evidence of trust.
